title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: The family hides their grilling of Nadesan about his girlfriend when Chandayatha unexpectedly arrives. Devastated by the secret kept from her, she breaks down to Cheran.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Annamalai angrily confronts Vijaya over her plan to send Nachiyar to an old-age home and sternly warns her against it. Furious, Vijaya questions Rohini for revealing her secret.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath explores near-death experiences as participants share survival, regrets and lessons from dangerous moments. Their experiences inspire them to find renewed purpose in life.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: As the competition intensifies, contestants race towards the finale while judges identify mistakes and mark corrections. With stakes rising, contestants strive to prove themselves.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Actors from Vijay TV serials, playing mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law, take on lively rounds with smart clues and fast answers. The Chase round keeps the outcome suspenseful.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 21: VJS Drops A Major Game Twist
description: VJS confronts about the passive gameplay and questions Avinash's board choices. Javeed, Lakshmi Priya and Saviniya return as VJS reveals a twist, sweeping everyone off their feet.
